integrity: All formulae are analytically derived; numerical tests corroborate but do not prove the continuum assertion. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The sampling law is the pushforward of uniform angular measure on a circle, not Euclidean ellipse arclength or planar interior area. The degenerate ellipse is only a limit. The dilogarithm formula for a different off-center-circle containment problem was known in 2018. Absolute historical priority is not established.
title: Dilogarithmic acuteness law for uniform-angle triangles on an ellipse
